content: Here INLINEFORM0 is the one-hot vector of the word INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 is the word embedding matrix which is shared across the source words. INLINEFORM3 is the recurrent unit computing the current hidden state of the encoder based on the previous hidden state. INLINEFORM4 is then called an annotation vector, which represent the information of the source sentence up to the time INLINEFORM5 from both forward and backward directions.
